description: PHP 8.4+ best practices; PHPUnit 11, Composer, PSR-12, Laravel, Symfony.

Tools: PHP 8.4.0; PHPUnit 11.5.0; Composer 2.8.0; Laravel 12.0.0; Symfony 7.3.5.
Integrations: `moai-foundation-trust`, `moai-core-code-reviewer`, `moai-essentials-debug`.
Follow language best practices
Use latest stable tool versions
Maintain test coverage ≥85%
Document all public APIs
Skip quality gates
Use deprecated tools
Ignore security warnings
Mix testing frameworks
